integrity: The full infinite relation ideal is proved to be generated by the degree-two equations. Finite exact code supplements but does not establish the all-degree statement. Relevant 2026 author source and Altmann 1994 primary text examined; unindexed equivalent calculation remains possible.
limitations: Specific analytic local deformation ring for one isolated Gorenstein toric threefold singularity; does not calculate global Calabi--Yau deformation functor. Isomorphic abstract algebra for a different pentagon appears in Altmann 1994. Universal construction and method are established prior work.
title: An embedded square-zero direction in the versal base of a nonsmoothable pentagon cone
